My work asks how much disease burden routine health information systems fail to record, and what statistical tools can recover it. I mainly use **R**, combining Bayesian modelling, interrupted time-series designs and geospatial analysis. Select a project to read more.

## <i class="bi bi-heart-pulse"></i> Maternal health {#maternal-health}

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.pcard .linked}
[Undergraduate thesis]{.tag}

### Maternal Mortality in Kenya, 2018–2025

An interrupted time-series and counterfactual analysis comparing trends in routine and audited surveillance data.

[Interrupted time series · Counterfactuals]{.methods} [Read more →](projects/maternal-mortality-kenya.qmd){.read-more .stretched-link}
:::

::: {.pcard .linked}
[Research proposal · AL for Health]{.tag}

### The Shadow Burden: Hidden Maternal Deaths in Nairobi

A proposed Bayesian spatial model to estimate maternal deaths missing from the records across Nairobi's 85 wards.

[Bayesian ZINB · BYM2 · R-INLA]{.methods} [Read more →](projects/nairobi-maternal-mortality.qmd){.read-more .stretched-link}
:::
:::

::: {.pcard .linked}
[Spatial epidemiology]{.tag}

### Conflict-Driven Acceleration of Malaria Exposure

A new Conflict Exposure Index and spatiotemporal framework for measuring how armed conflict reshaped malaria exposure in Cameroon, 2010–2024.

[Conflict Exposure Index · DiD-ITS · GIS]{.methods} [Read more →](projects/malaria-conflict-cameroon.qmd){.read-more .stretched-link}

## <i class="bi bi-activity"></i> Surveillance & outbreaks {#surveillance}

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.pcard .linked}
[Field epidemiology · KNPHI & KUTRRH]{.tag}

### Field Attachment: KUTRRH & KNPHI, 2026

A hospital Mpox investigation, ward IPC inspections, appraisal of national outbreak reports, Ebola preparedness and a review of Kenya's digital surveillance systems.

[IDSR · Contact tracing · Outbreak analysis]{.methods} [Read more →](projects/surveillance-kenya.qmd){.read-more .stretched-link}
:::

::: {.pcard .linked}
[Community field study · Cameroon]{.tag}

### Diagnostic Baseline for Batoukop

A free one-month clinic that produced the community's first prevalence data for malaria, typhoid serology and anemia.

[Prevalence survey · Referral pathways]{.methods} [Read more →](projects/batoukop-diagnostics.qmd){.read-more .stretched-link}
:::
:::
